en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall cylindrical stone tower with a small entrance door, narrow windows, and a viewing platform ringed by a railing near the top. The tower stands on a rocky hill and is surrounded by a low stone wall with metal fencing. Sparse trees and scrubby vegetation appear in the foreground. Printed text in German at the upper left reads "Wurzen i. Sa.  Bismarckturm." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
